sections.name: Auth
sections.title: Auth & Security
sections.description: JWT authentication, token expiration, and external auth configuration.

fields.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens. Change this to invalidate all existing tokens.
Number of days before a JWT token expires and requires re-authentication.
Database provider for the Identity (auth) database. This controls the database backend, NOT the authentication mode.
URL of an external authentication provider. When set, RemoteLoginManager is used instead of local login.
Name of the HTTP cookie that stores the JWT token.
List of JWT token identifiers that have been explicitly revoked.

sections.name: DefaultAdmin
sections.title: Default Admin
sections.description: Credentials for the default administrator account created on first run.

fields.description: Email address of the default admin user.
Username of the default admin user.
Password for the default admin account.

sections.name: Providers
sections.title: Database & Cache Providers
sections.description: Backend providers for the registry database, Hangfire jobs, and caching.

fields.description: Database provider for the main Registry database (datasets, organizations, etc.).
Pinned MySQL/MariaDB server version (e.g. 8.0.36-mysql, 10.11.6-mariadb). Empty: auto-detected once per connection string on first use.
Storage backend for Hangfire background jobs.
Caching backend for thumbnails, tiles, and dataset visibility. Null means InMemory.

sections.name: StoragePaths
sections.title: Storage Paths
sections.description: Filesystem paths for Registry data, datasets, cache, and temporary files.

fields.description: Root storage path for Registry data (identity DB, config, etc.).
Directory where dataset archives and extracted content are stored.
Directory for file-based cache (thumbnails, tiles, etc.).
Directory for temporary files during processing.

sections.name: Upload
sections.title: Upload Settings
sections.description: Request body size limits, batch upload timeouts, and token configuration.

fields.description: Maximum HTTP request body size in bytes. Null means unlimited.
Maximum duration for a batch upload session before it expires.
Length of randomly generated batch upload tokens. Must be at least 8.
Most files the Hub may bundle in one upload request (small files are bundled to save round trips).
Largest chunk accepted by the resumable upload of large files.
How long one evaluation of a user's storage use serves their uploads (their sizes are added to it).
How long the OGC and dataset-thumbnail invalidations of uploaded files are collected before they run once.
Background workers that generate the thumbnails of uploaded images ahead of their first view.

sections.name: Downloads
sections.title: Download Settings
sections.description: Concurrent download limits and anonymous bulk download restrictions.

fields.description: Maximum simultaneous downloads per user. Null = unlimited.
When true, anonymous users cannot download bulk archives (whole dataset, folders, multi-file). Single-file downloads remain allowed.

sections.name: Cache
sections.title: Cache Expiration
sections.description: TTL for cached thumbnails, tiles, dataset visibility, authorization facts, and cache cleanup interval.

fields.description: How long thumbnail images are cached before regeneration.
How long map tiles are cached before regeneration.
How long dataset visibility settings are cached.
How long a user's roles and existence are reused across requests for access checks.
How long a dataset lookup by slug is reused across requests. Changes made on this instance apply at once.
How often the file cache is scanned and stale entries are removed.

sections.name: RedisConfig
sections.title: Redis Configuration
sections.description: Redis connection and cache settings. Only applied when Cache Provider is set to Redis. Current provider: InMemory.

sections.name: CronJobs
sections.title: Cron Jobs
sections.description: Recurring background job schedules (cron expressions) and retention periods.

fields.description: Cron expression for cleaning up expired Hangfire jobs. Default: '0 * * * *' (hourly). Set to 'disabled' to remove.
Cron expression for reconciling JobIndex states across restarts. Default: '0 * * * *' (hourly).
Cron expression for completing indexed job publications interrupted before the job became runnable. Default: '* * * * *' (every minute).
Cron expression for retrying pending builds. Default: '0 */6 * * *' (every 6 hours).
Cron expression for cleaning up orphaned dataset folders. Default: '0 3 * * *' (daily at 3 AM).
Cron expression for full DDB cleanup (entries + build artifacts) on all datasets. Default: '0 0 * * *' (daily at midnight).
Cron expression for scanning entries and rebuilding incomplete artifacts. Default: '0 2 * * *' (daily at 2 AM).
Cron expression for purging old terminal JobIndex records. Default: '0 4 * * *' (daily at 4 AM).
Number of days to keep terminal (Succeeded/Failed/Deleted) JobIndex records.
Expiration timeout for succeeded Hangfire jobs. Failed jobs are kept for diagnostics. Minimum: 1 day.
MySQL storage: hours before a running job is considered abandoned and eligible for re-dequeue. Raise for long-running builds. Minimum: 1 hour.

sections.name: PasswordPolicy
sections.title: Password Policy
sections.description: Password complexity requirements. When null in config, no policy is enforced.

fields.description: Minimum number of characters required for passwords.
Password must contain at least one numeric digit.
Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
Password must contain at least one non-alphanumeric character.

sections.name: HubOptions
sections.title: Hub Options
sections.description: UI branding, white-label customization, and feature visibility toggles.

fields.description: URL of the navbar logo. Use /branding/... for user-supplied assets.
Display name used as document title. Defaults to 'DroneDB' when null.
CSS icon class or URL shown next to app name. Defaults to 'icon-dronedb'.
Whether to show the registration link on the login page.
Hides the 'New dataset' button and all dataset creation entry-points.
Hides the per-user storage indicator in the header.
Hides account-management menu items. Useful with external auth.
When set, routes users directly to this organization slug (single-tenant mode).
Hides organization create/delete/edit actions.
Favicon and web manifest configuration: FaviconIco, Favicon16, Favicon32, AppleTouchIcon, Manifest, ThemeColor. Files should be placed under {StoragePath}/branding/.

sections.name: OrgManagement
sections.title: Organization Management
sections.description: Controls for organization member management and default user organizations.

fields.description: When enabled, organization owners can manage members. When disabled, only system admins can.
When enabled, new users automatically get a personal default organization.

sections.name: Thumbnails
sections.title: Thumbnails
sections.description: Remote thumbnail generator URL, default size, and candidate file names.

fields.description: URL of a remote thumbnail generator service. Null uses the local generator.
Shared secret between the web server and the ThumbnailGenerator host. Generated on first start when empty.
Default thumbnail size in pixels when no size is specified.
File names (in dataset root) considered as dataset thumbnail candidates, in priority order.
Map tiles and map images rendered at once by this instance. 0 = half the CPU cores (at least 2).
Thumbnails and coverages rendered at once by this instance. 0 = a quarter of the CPU cores (at least 1).

sections.name: ExportZip
sections.title: Export & Zip
sections.description: Maximum GeoTIFF export sizes. ZIP downloads are streamed and need no memory threshold.

fields.description: Maximum estimated output size for GeoTIFF raster export. Null = unlimited.

sections.name: LdapSettings
sections.title: LDAP / Active Directory
sections.description: LDAP authentication settings. Mutually exclusive with ExternalAuthUrl.

fields.description: Enables LDAP/Active Directory authentication. Mutually exclusive with ExternalAuthUrl.
LDAP server hostname (e.g., 'ldap.example.com' or 'dc.domain.com').
LDAP port: 389 for plain LDAP, 636 for LDAPS.
Use SSL/TLS (LDAPS) for the connection. Strongly recommended in production.
Validate the server SSL certificate chain. Disable only for self-signed certs in testing.
Base DN for searches (e.g., 'dc=example,dc=com').
Service account DN for the initial search bind. Null for anonymous bind.
Password for the Bind DN service account.
Optional format string for constructing user principal directly. {0} is replaced with username.
LDAP attribute for the user email address. AD default: 'mail'.
LDAP attribute for the display name. AD default: 'displayName'.
LDAP attribute listing group memberships. Default: 'memberOf'.
LDAP search filter to locate user entry. {0} is replaced with the username.
Distinguished names of LDAP groups whose members receive the Registry admin role.
Timeout in seconds for LDAP operations.

sections.name: Smtp
sections.title: E-mail (SMTP)
sections.description: Outgoing e-mail server. While disabled, every e-mail is logged and dropped. Test it with POST /sys/email/test.

fields.description: Sends e-mail through the server below.
SMTP server host name (e.g., 'smtp.example.com').
587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL on connect, 25 for a local relay.
StartTls: upgrade with STARTTLS (required). SslOnConnect: TLS from the start. None: no encryption (local relay only).
Validate the server certificate chain. Disable only for a test server with a self-signed certificate (it must still match the host name).
SMTP account user name. Leave empty (with the password) for no authentication.
SMTP account password. Prefer the AppSettings__Smtp__Password environment variable.
Address the e-mails are sent from.
Display name of the sender. Empty: the Hub application name.
Address replies go to, when it is not the sender's.
Timeout of each SMTP operation.

sections.name: BuildNotifications
sections.title: Build notifications
sections.description: E-mails to the users who asked for them in their preferences (none by default, all, or only failed builds) when their builds complete or fail for good. Needs the e-mail server (AppSettings:Smtp). The text is edited under E-mail templates.

fields.description: How long the first finished build of a user waits for the others: one e-mail lists every build of that user that ended in the window.

sections.name: UpdateCheck
sections.title: Update check
sections.description: Update check: enabled (daily). This deployment sends its instance ID (<guid>), Registry/DroneDB versions, platform, public URL, host name, network domain and declared use to dronedb.app, and a contact email only if an admin opted in; dronedb.app also records the source IP address and checks the public URL. Purposes: update notices, release notes and license-compliance verification. Docs: docs.dronedb.app/docs/registry/admin/update-check  ·  Opt out: UpdateCheckCron="disabled"

fields.description: Cron expression of the daily update check. Empty: once a day at a time that depends on the instance. Set to 'disabled' to switch the check off: nothing is sent.

Which updates are e-mailed to the administrators: 'security' (only updates with security fixes), 'all' or 'off'. E-mail is off (AppSettings:Smtp is not enabled): no update e-mail is sent, whatever this is set to.
The identity of this deployment, to quote in a request to delete the data held about it.

sections.name: ProcessingPlatform
sections.title: Processing Platform
sections.description: Task substrate settings: concurrency limits, dedup, NodeODX nodes, and bulk download thresholds.

fields.description: Hours before a produced artifact's WorkDir is swept.
Maximum concurrent heavy tasks per user.
Maximum queued (pending) heavy tasks per user.
Maximum concurrent heavy tasks per organization.
Hard cap on concurrent heavy tasks across all users.
Hard cap on estimated output size per task submission.
Maximum compressed archive size accepted by archive-extract tool.
Disk head-room kept free during archive extraction. 0 to disable.
Default tile size in pixels for windowed raster export.
Size threshold above which bulk downloads are offloaded to async task.
Maximum active bulk-download tasks per user.
Enable task deduplication (prevent duplicate submissions).
Time window for deduplication checks.
Maximum lines returned by log tail endpoint.
Maximum bytes returned by log tail endpoint.
Minimum seconds between progress updates.
Poll interval for remote NodeODX nodes.
Maximum backoff for remote node polling.
HTTP request timeout for remote NodeODX nodes.
Maximum active import-file (single-file URL import) tasks per user.
Per-organization daily output size budget in bytes, keyed by org slug ('default' is the fallback).
Array of NodeODX processing node configurations. Each entry: { Id, Url, Token, Title }.

sections.name: ProcessingPlatform
sections.title: Tool Gating
sections.description: Per-tool feature gating: hide or disable specific heavy tools, and restrict them by role or organization.

fields.description: JSON object keyed by tool id (e.g. "photogrammetry"). Each entry accepts: availability (Enabled|Disabled|Hidden), disabledMessage, allowedRoles (array), allowedOrgs (array), hideWhenNotAllowed (bool), maxConcurrentPerUser, maxQueuedPerUser. Omit a tool to use the default (Enabled, no restrictions).

sections.name: ProcessingBudget
sections.title: Processing Budget
sections.description: Background job concurrency and per-build native limits. 0 = derived from the host. Effective: 1 heavy worker(s) x 2 build thread(s), 2 light worker(s), 1 background rebuild x 2 thread(s), build cache 1024 MB, warp memory 512 MB.

fields.description: Concurrent jobs that run native builds ("builds" queue). Effective: 1.
Concurrent other jobs ("tasks" and "default" queues). Effective: 2.
Threads per native build (DDB_BUILD_THREADS). Effective: 2.
Threads of the background rebuild of entries built with an older layout ("rebuilds" queue, one build at a time; 0 = 2). Effective: 2.
GDAL block cache during a raster build (DDB_COG_CACHE_MB). Effective: 1024 MB.
GDAL warp memory during a raster build (DDB_WARP_MEMORY_MB). Effective: 512 MB.

sections.name: HostBudget
sections.title: Host Budget
sections.description: The machine and the Registry processes that share it: each process takes its weight's share of the cores and memory (processing budget, render lanes, libddb's CPU pool). Not declared: each process plans the whole machine.

fields.description: Logical processors of the machine; 0 = what each process sees.
Memory of the machine; 0 = what each process sees.
Web server processes on the machine.
Processing node processes on the machine.
Thumbnail generator processes on the machine.
Disk-bound threads for the whole machine, split like the cores; 0 = libddb's default per process.

sections.name: Import
sections.title: Import Dataset
sections.description: Import settings: size limits, allowed source types, SSRF guard, timeouts, and concurrency.

fields.description: Maximum total bytes that can be imported in a single task. 0 = unlimited.
Allowed import source types. Null/empty = all sources allowed. Values: 'registry', 'archive-url'.
Allow outbound connections to private/loopback/link-local addresses.
Hostnames explicitly exempt from SSRF blocking.
Maximum HTTP redirects to follow during import.
Connection/authentication timeout per source.
Total transfer timeout per import task.
Number of files downloaded in parallel from a remote registry.
Maximum retry attempts per file download against a remote registry.
Maximum size of a single file imported from URL (0 = fall back to MaxImportSizeBytes).
Minimum sustained download speed before import is aborted (0 = disable).
Time window for low-speed detection and hard stall timeout.
File extensions rejected by all ingestion paths (block-list). Ignored when AllowedFileExtensions is non-empty.
File extensions accepted by all ingestion paths (allow-list). When non-empty, switches to allow-list mode and ignores BlockedFileExtensions.

sections.name: ConnectionStrings
sections.title: Connection Strings
sections.description: Database connection strings for Identity and Registry databases.

fields.description: Connection string for the Identity (auth) database.
Connection string for the main Registry database.

sections.name: Serilog
sections.title: Serilog Logging
sections.description: Logging configuration: minimum level and file output path.

fields.description: Minimum severity level for log output. Values: Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Fatal.

Path to the log file output. Each instance type writes its own file: the web server, processing node and thumbnail generator add -web, -node and -thumbs to the file name (e.g. registry-web.txt); the default all-in-one instance uses it as is. Files roll daily.

sections.name: Misc
sections.title: Miscellaneous
sections.description: Worker threads, CORS origins, external URL override, random name length, and data protection keys.

fields.description: Number of worker threads. 0 or -1 uses ASP.NET default.
Allowed CORS origins. Null or empty = all origins allowed.
IP addresses of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For/X-Forwarded-Proto headers are trusted. Null or empty = loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1). When set, it replaces loopback.

Networks (CIDR, e.g. 172.16.0.0/12) whose addresses are trusted as reverse proxies, in addition to Known Proxies. Needed behind a port published by Docker, where the peer is the bridge gateway. Null or empty = none.
Overrides the external URL used in generated links and redirects.
Length of randomly generated dataset names. Must be at least 8.
Enables per-user storage quota enforcement.
Path to shared directory for ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. Required when processing node runs separately without Redis.
Token for health check endpoints (/health, /quickhealth).
